picks.title: GTA V NPCs Can Now Talk Back In Real Time With AI-Powered NPCTalk Mod, Free Release Coming Next Week
picks.rationale: A new free mod adds real-time AI voice conversations to GTA V NPCs with 1.15-2.2 second response times, a concrete, measurable benchmark for conversational NPC design.
picks.excerpt: NPCTalk introduces real-time AI conversations for GTA V NPCs, enabling dynamic dialogue and interactions with 1.15-2.2 seconds response times.

picks.title: Roblox brings Audioscape team in-house to develop AI audio tools
picks.rationale: Roblox is folding Audioscape's AI audio technology into its creator tools, which brings generative sound and music to the platform's creator toolchain.
picks.excerpt: Roblox has brought the team behind AI audio startup Audioscape into the company and its technology will now become part of the platform's creator tools.

picks.title: [오늘의 스팀] AI를 속여라, 협동 신작 '스캠 위드 유어 프렌즈'
picks.rationale: A co-op game built around conning a generative-AI character hit the top of Steam's global charts in early access. It is a live case of AI as the core mechanic, and its server and voice-recognition failures are lessons for designers.
picks.excerpt: 협동 시뮬레이션 신작 스캠 위드 유어 프렌즈가 스팀 앞서 해보기로 출시된 후 전 세계 최고 인기 게임 최상위권에 올랐다. 생성형 AI를 상대로 사기극을 벌인다는 독특한 설정과 협동 과정에서 발생하는 재미있는 상황이 이목을 끌었다. 다만 불안정한 서버와 음성 인식 오류 및 최적화 ...

picks.title: Oblivion Remastered Mod Built Using Claude AI Boosts FPS By Over 40% And Drastically Reduces Stuttering Without Sacrificing Visual Quality
picks.rationale: A newly released mod built with Claude claims over 40% more FPS and less stutter in Oblivion Remastered. It is a measurable AI-assisted optimisation result, unlike the earlier ports and reuploads that drew slop complaints.
picks.excerpt: AI-assisted mod Oblivion Remastered Performance Fix boosts FPS by over 40% while enhancing visuals on Ryzen 7 5800X/RX 9070 XT systems.

picks.title: 부산서 열리는 유니티 AI 게임잼, 참가자 모집한다
picks.rationale: Unity and the Korea Game Industry Association are recruiting for a 24-hour AI game jam at BEXCO before G-STAR 2026. Sign-ups close October 20, so Korean developers can act on it right away.
picks.excerpt: 유니티와 한국게임산업협회가 '유니티 AI 게임잼' 참가자를 10월 12일부터 20일까지 모집한다고 밝혔다. 이번 행사는 국내 최대 게임쇼인 '지스타 2026' 개막에 앞서 11월 18일부터 19일까지 부산 벡스코에서 24시간 무박 일정으로 열릴 예정이다
